'''Ra Yasht''' was a [[Professor/Legends|professor]] from [[Beshka University]].

Along with fellow professor [[Skarten]], Ra Yasht published the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[Torture Observed: An Interview with Jabba's Cook]]''.
